Reading mode for your series, a chapter dock in the reader, and chapter lists that can run newest first.

• Reading mode: a switch on the series page swaps the volume shelf for every chapter in the order the source lists them. Read any of them in place, streamed or downloaded, with a button straight to where you left off. The list scrolls with the page and its header stays pinned, so even a thousand-chapter series opens instantly.
• Chapter dock in the reader: hover near the bottom of the page (or tap the middle on a phone) to jump to the previous or next chapter, or open a picker that scrolls through every chapter like an iPhone wheel.
• Newest first: every chapter list — reading mode, the volume panel, the reader's picker and Discover — can flip to show the latest chapter at the top. One switch flips them all.
• The page slider and the chapter dock now appear together.
• Fixed: for a streamed series, "next chapter" could skip ahead when a volume listed a later chapter before earlier ones.
